Aggregate readiness and no sev-one incidents support certification generally, but the unresolved HR slice and incomplete runbook make support weaker unless the packet frames certification as consistent with disclosure obligations. That keeps velocity while staying inside the admissible evidence and stated policy.

Public AI risk guidance supports measuring and managing residual risk through deployment, and public model-card guidance supports documenting limitations and evaluation results. The admissible record also shows a remaining weakness in the HR benefits enrollment slice, concentrated in leave-policy eligibility guidance, and the current draft mitigation is not complete because owner and alert threshold are still TBD. Under the stated disclosure policy, that means certification is best defended only if the audit packet treats the issue as a disclosed material limitation rather than claiming there are no material limitations.
